Priya S: Hey! New hire Qs 4b Hola. I started 4/13. Two quick things: 1) there's a company holiday on 4/22 389 do new hires get holiday pay if they started last week? 2) my benefits card and Ramp card are both delayed 4b3 I paid for an eye exam (dependent) and FSA-eligible meds. Can I get reimbursed before my first paycheck?
People Ops: Welcome Priya! :tada: Short answers: holiday pay depends on payroll cutoff (we'll confirm below). Reimbursements: yes 539 either off-cycle via Concur + ops email or request a virtual Ramp card for immediate needs. For FSA/HSA specific claims, send receipts to benefits@redwood.com (rx/medical) or submit via the FSA portal.
Jordan P: Payroll detail: cutoff for the 4/22 holiday run is 2029-04-18 17:00 PT. If your hire was processed before that you'll be included. Off-cycle reimbursements typically take 2-4 business days after approvals; bank cutoffs may affect same-week posting.
Priya S: I completed enrollment during onboarding but benefits card still shows "in transit". Dependent exam receipt is from yesterday. If I submit to benefits@redwood.com, will that be an FSA claim or general benefits reimbursement?
Benefits Bot: Automated: prescriptions and medical visits tied to enrolled plans should be submitted to benefits@redwood.com with claim type "FSA" or "HRA" as applicable. Attach itemized receipt and explanation. For employer-paid holiday eligibility, contact payroll@redwood.com if you need confirmation.
People Ops: Practical flow: 1) If you want funds fast: request virtual Ramp card (reply here and we'll approve + cc your manager). 2) If you prefer direct reimbursement: submit Concur expense, tag it "onboarding-med", attach receipts, then email ops@redwood.com with Concur link + manager cc and subject "Off-cycle reimbursement - new hire". 3) For FSA/HSA claims submit to benefits@redwood.com and we'll coordinate with the FSA admin; those sometimes reimburse directly to you or to the plan depending on carrier.
Lara M: Hi Priya 44b I can approve the off-cycle immediately if you file Concur and CC me. If you want the virtual card, I can ack the approval in-thread so Ops/Finance can push it through.
Priya S: Thanks Lara! I'll file Concur now and also email benefits with the Rx + exam receipt. One more Q: if FSA reimburses separately, will finance still do an off-cycle for the moving/exam charges? I just want to avoid double-claiming.
People Ops: Good catch. Don't double-claim: label the Concur expense appropriately. If it's an FSA-eligible medical expense you're submitting to benefits, note in Concur that the claim is pending with benefits and include the benefits case ID once available. Finance will hold off on duplicate payments.
Jordan P: Also note: for holiday pay eligibility, having W-4 and direct deposit set in payroll portal is required before cutoff. If anything's missing DM me and I'll check.
Priya S: I confirmed W-4 + direct deposit during onboarding. Filing Concur + emailing benefits now. Appreciate the help everyone :sparkles:
